content.text: There appears to be port conflicts when running fcrepo4-release-tests while fcrepo4 is also running.
The resolution of this ticket will be limited to updating pom.xml/maven build-time configuration.
Part of this ticket is to figure out where the fix should be made.
Try to reproduce this ticket. My understandings is:
2. Fcrepo4 master branch running in tomcat 8080
Tests run: 1, Failures: 1, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0, Time elapsed: 11.308 sec <<< FAILURE! - in org.fcrepo.it.SparqlRecipesIT
, the 5xx is almost certainly due to the server not coming up correctly... port conflict.
@awoods. Yes, I know, just wonder why Mike see the port conflict in his error message but no mine.
's error was found higher in the output log.
@awoods are you able to see the #duraspace-ff now, or please check the chat log if you have time.
In reference to a since deleted comment by myself indicating a different error:

My error was apparently not on the latest version... I apologize for wasting your time.  My local copy was before the repo moved and my "git pull" didn't report any changes so I assumed I was up to date.
2.  Ran mvn clean install for fcrepo-release-tests
ERROR 11:23:03.650 (BrokerService) Failed to start Apache ActiveMQ ([localhost, ID:localhost.localdomain-49653-1426087383504-0:1], {})

java.io.IOException: Transport Connector could not be registered in JMX: Failed to bind to server socket: tcp://0.0.0.0:61616?maximumConnections=1000&wireformat.maxFrameSize=104857600 due to: java.net.BindException: Address already in use
I suppose we need to use a free random port for that too?
Try to add activemq dynamic port in pom.xml.
PR-8 has been merged with the master branch.
With recent updates, now fcrepo4-release-tests has a port conflict with 3030.
This issue will be resolved with a local instance of Fuseki can be running on the default port 3030 and fcrepo4-release-tests pass when running:

The resolution of this ticket will be limited to updating pom.xml/maven build-time configuration.
which pom.xml file? https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo-message-consumer/blob/master/fcrepo-message-consumer-core/pom.xml this one?

Possibly the fcrepo-message-consumer-core/pom.xml
...and/or the fcrepo4-release-tests/pom.xml

Part of this ticket is to figure out where the fix should be made.

Try to reproduce this ticket. My understandings is:

1. Fuseki running 3030
2. Fcrepo4 master branch running in tomcat 8080
2.1 install https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo-message-consumer
3. git clone https://github.com/mikedurbin/fcrepo4-release-tests
4. cd fcrepo4-release-tests
5. mvn clean install

Any thing missing?

• Step 2.1 should not be necessary.
  • Step 3 should be:
    git clone https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo4-release-tests

Otherwise, this looks good.
